POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Vehicle body, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body.

2. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.
   D. Skip safety briefings for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

6. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

7. When learning Vehicle body joining processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Vehicle body joining processes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Vehicle body joining processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Vehicle body joining processes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.

8. When learning Evolution of motor vehicles, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution of motor vehicles.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Evolution of motor vehicles.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.

9. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle Chassis.

10. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Road wheels.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

12. When learning Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Road wheels and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Vehicle body and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon.

3. A — CPU

4. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

5. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Vehicle body joining processes.

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution of motor vehicles.

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels.

11. D — Information and Communication Technology

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle body Joining processes 4.0 Engines 4.1 I.
